content.text: Arrows change  Enter swap  B back

scripts.update_narrative:
local s = ctx.sceneState
s.narrative_1 = ''
s.narrative_2 = ''
s.narrative_3 = ''
if s.desk == 'Journal' and s.bed == 'Lamp' and s.shelf == 'Toy' then
    s.narrative_1 = 'Everything is exactly as he left it.'
    s.narrative_2 = 'It feels frozen in time.'
elseif s.desk == 'Toy' then
    s.narrative_1 = 'The toy sits on the desk now.'
    s.narrative_2 = 'He always wanted it close while studying.'
elseif s.bed == 'Journal' then
    s.narrative_1 = 'The journal lies on the bed.'
    s.narrative_2 = 'You resist the urge to open it.'
else
    s.narrative_1 = 'The room feels different.'
    s.narrative_2 = 'Like someone else lives here now.'
end
if s.selected == 1 then
    s.narrative_3 = '> Desk selected'
elseif s.selected == 2 then
    s.narrative_3 = '> Bed selected'
elseif s.selected == 3 then
    s.narrative_3 = '> Shelf selected'
end
scripts.swap_item:
local s = ctx.sceneState
local items = {s.desk, s.bed, s.shelf}
local sel = s.selected
local next_idx = sel % 3 + 1
local temp = items[sel]
items[sel] = items[next_idx]
items[next_idx] = temp
s.desk = items[1]
s.bed = items[2]
s.shelf = items[3]
